issues.title: Future guide: fair Pokémon trading examples, trade-evolution checklist and safe link trades
issues.body:
## User request — future improvement (recorded 21 November 2026)

Add **two helpful original-language guide pages**, consistently accessible from both the old ChatGPT Workspace edition A and independent GitHub/IONOS edition B. **This is a future feature, not authorization to change either guide during the current side-mission audit.**

### 1. Popular, fair trading examples
- Explain **how to judge fairness**: availability in this game and DLC, one-time vs repeatable capture, level, Alpha/shiny status, nature/IV/effort, rarity of form/held items, special distribution provenance and real player preferences. **There is no official fixed exchange rate** for Pokémon. Do not claim a trade is universally fair or guaranteed accepted.
- Suggested categories for **research and player-friendly examples**, not preset values: common-for-common Pokédex swaps; counterpart trade evolutions (e.g. Haunter ↔ Haunter with equivalent conditions); version-specific/DLC-availability swaps where applicable; rare-for-rare and shinies **only with clear caveats and informed consent**.
- Provide a **tradeback safety** box: trusted person vs random community code; never assume the stranger will return your original Pokémon; inspect species, form, shiny and held item before confirming; don't hand away a one-time legendary or valuable shiny as a 'temporary trade' to a random player.
- Distinguish **in-game NPC trades** from human-to-human Link Trade, and **Pokémon HOME transfer** from in-game Link Trade; separate their constraints and whether trades or moves trigger evolution.
- No external real-money trade market, account sharing, paid middlemen or attempts to circumvent game safeguards.

### 2. Comprehensive trade-evolution checklist for Pokémon Legends: Z-A + Mega Dimension
- For each *obtainable in the relevant edition*, list Pokémon → evolution, whether human Link Trade is needed, held item, where to get that item, any alternative direct encounter/NPC trade, game or DLC availability, and safe directions.
- Based on **secondary, preliminary research only** (must be verified before article publication), the base list includes Kadabra→Alakazam, Machoke→Machamp, Haunter→Gengar, Phantump→Trevenant, Pumpkaboo→Gourgeist, Onix+Metal Coat→Steelix, Scyther+Metal Coat→Scizor, Slowpoke+King's Rock→Slowking, Spritzee+Sachet→Aromatisse, Swirlix+Whipped Dream→Slurpuff. Mega Dimension may add Porygon+Up-Grade→Porygon2, Porygon2+Dubious Disc→Porygon-Z, Feebas+Prism Scale→Milotic. **Check actual game/DLC Pokédex and evolution methods**; avoid importing the *Legends: Arceus* Linking Cord mechanic into Z-A without evidence.
- Separate item evolutions that **do not require Link Trade** (e.g. Galarian Slowpoke uses Galarica Cuff/Wreath) so readers don't waste time. Verify every item/method and note any alternative catch.
- Nintendo's **official** connection instructions: https://en-americas-support.nintendo.com/app/answers/detail/a_id/68627/ — Link Play → Link Trade → Nearby/Faraway → matching eight-digit code → inspect offer → confirm. Online requirements and subscription must be checked.
- Community trade-code matching conventions are **unofficial** and not guaranteed safe or active; test before recommending and display fair swap warnings. Examples: https://poketrainervault.com/legends-za/guides/trade-evolution-link-codes/ and https://www.pockettactics.com/pokemon-legends-z-a/trade-codes
- Sources to corroborate evolution requirements: https://www.serebii.net/legendsz-a/ingametrades.shtml ; https://www.serebii.net/legendsz-a/sidemissions.shtml ; Nintendo Support above; Pokédex, game or video receipts.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fact-check against game-specific official mechanics and two specialist sources, record disagreements in shared ledger; distinguish game versions and DLC.
- [ ] Draft both pages in independent **review PR** without replacing original pages, making external-site redirects or modifying `main` gameplay before tests.
- [ ] Use same navigation and **Back to Walkthrough**, mobile accessible; add crosslinks in Pokémon Pokédex and relevant side missions (#002 Pikachu-for-Heracross, #024 Abra-for-Riolu, #039 Slowpoke-for-Galarian Slowpoke, #075 Galarica items).
- [ ] Provide searchable/tickable evolution list with persistent saved IDs **only after validating compatibility with existing 634 progress keys**; no localStorage resets.
- [ ] Apply only to A when original Workspace editor/source is accessible; mark **two-site parity** only after separate publication and QA in both.
- [ ] Keep Stream Bandit Supabase, IONOS, live original Site, reports #13/#14, and Stream Bandit TCG untouched during this backlog feature.

**Tracking:** canonical [two-site parity ledger](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/main/ATLAS_DUAL_SITE_FIX_LEDGER.md).

## User-requested future improvement — 21 November 2026

**Goal:** Make the entire Pokémon Atlas guide operate as **one connected completion walkthrough**, rather than a set of separate pages that force players to backtrack through menus. Record this now; **do not implement until a suitable, verified navigation upgrade**, because the original ChatGPT Workspace source is still inaccessible.

### Navigation contract for BOTH versions
- Preserve the **same global menu used on the Overview page** across all major sections; retain the existing **Back to Walkthrough** action (it must return to the interactive Walkthrough, not Overview).
- Add **compact, consistently positioned quick-access links** on important pages, such as **Walkthrough ›**, **Side Quests ›**, **Items & Rewards ›**, **Wild Zone Maps ›**, **Pokédex ›** and **DLC ›** (only to existing supported sections; adapt menu to viewport, no unrelated replacement navigation).
- Add **contextual, bidirectional deep links** from any **Main Mission N** to side quests unlocked/required at that step, mapped items, shops, trainers, rewards, Alpha encounters, ladder/Holovator/scaffold route, and back to that precise walkthrough point. Example: *Mission 34 → Side Mission 092 Beldum Blockade Holovator → mapped lift access → return to Mission 34*.
- Quest cards should link to relevant **Wild Zone map pins and item checklist entries**; pins should link back to the quest/mission and item record, using verified sources only. Example: *Side Mission 017 Shiny Mareep → Wild Zone 1 rooftop ladders → return to Side Mission 017*.
- Item/Shop pages should link the item to **when it's useful**, **where to buy/find it**, **required NPC/side quest**, evolution prerequisites (with future issue #7) and nearby map landmarks. Preserve optional items and one-time choices.
- Navigation should include simple, readable **back-to-context** links, **breadcrumbs where helpful**, and strong access to Walkthrough and Side Quests even on mobile. Keep previous heading/scroll state when returning if feasible, and do not break local progress or checked items.
- Support both **normal base-game** and **Mega Dimension DLC** routes, with real progress gates. Link trade-evolution questions to **future issue #7** after fact-checking.
- **No invented coordinates or false item acquisition paths.** Bad/missing targets remain explicitly unresolved in the audit ledger.

### Acceptance tests / no-loss requirements
1. Produce a cross-link inventory: all 42 main mission entries, 200 numbered side missions + EX1–EX3, all 20 Wild Zone maps, item/Alpha/shops/rewards and DLC sections. Measure broken links before/after.
2. Map every intended link to a stable target (existing IDs or migrated equivalent). **Do not rename/replace progress checkbox IDs**, including the 634 unique stored keys in the recovered capture, without a proven migration plan.
3. Build simple test paths: Walkthrough → related Side Quest → specific item pickup/map pin → return to original Walkthrough step; DLC path; player mobile navigation. Test deep link, browser back/forward, checked-state persistence, keyboard focus and Android responsive layout.
4. Preserve the Overview menu **and** Back to Walkthrough; shortcuts **add** access, never replace the shared global menu.
5. Cross-site parity: **A** original live ChatGPT Site and **B** independent repo must be compared from **actual editable Workspace source**, then updated independently as supported. Record distinct source version/PR/SHA, URL, and Android/desktop verification in [dual-site ledger](https://github.com/trevieisking/lumiose-atlas-pokemon-za/blob/main/ATLAS_DUAL_SITE_FIX_LEDGER.md).
